constructions.concise_notes: All 4 combinations of regular/satisfied × client/customer are fully grammatical and natural across all routine and satisfaction-focused contexts without lexical leakage.
All 4 combinations of important/valuable × client/customer are semantically valid and felicitous under strategic-priority and high-revenue contexts without lexical leakage.
All 4 combinations of unhappy/loyal × client/customer are coherent and grammatical across grievance and long-standing patronage contexts without lexical leakage.
